audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive (W) grounds. Grounding shuts off dashes, and Elastic Slingshot (E) is Zac's only dash and his only engage. Neither layer mentions grounding anywhere; the full layer instead names Fling as the matchup-defining cooldown in breakdown.cooldowns, focus, loading and dosFull.
audit.why: It is the reason this matchup is Zac's worst in the slice at 40.63%, and it is completely absent from the entry. Singed does not need to dodge the engage — he denies it, from 1000 range, on a 17s cooldown at rank 1, by putting goo on the floor before Zac ever charges. Every piece of advice in the entry that says 'save E to pin him' or 'time your engage' is unworkable while the goo is down, and the player is never told why his E keeps failing to fire. The _missing-interactions file flags exactly this and it never reached either layer.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive (W): 17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range, slows and GROUNDS. While you stand in it, Elastic Slingshot will not fire. Charge E from outside the goo or after it expires — that cooldown, not Fling, is the gate on this lane.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it', grounding flag, cooldown 17/16/15/14/13, range 1000)

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion (R) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. Zac's entire sustain model is Cell Division blob pickups. Neither layer connects the two — content mid attributes his level-6 spike to 'move speed and tenacity' instead.
audit.why: This is the actual mechanism behind the number the entry already notices. content mid says '6 is where the WR bleeds' and then gives the wrong reason. Once Singed drinks, standing anywhere near his trail halves the healing from every blob Zac picks up — and blob healing is not a side benefit for Zac, it is the whole reason he can stay in a lane at all. Naming it correctly also gives the player something to do about it (fight before the drink, or step out of the trail before collecting), which 'he has tenacity' does not.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion: 100s flat. While active his Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds, halving your blob healing. Take the fight before he drinks, and collect blobs outside the trail.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (Insanity Potion: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds', antiHeal flag, cooldown 100)

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[0].text writes 'his Fling (Q)'. Fling is Singed's E. His Q is Poison Trail.
audit.why: It attaches the flip to the wrong key, and it is the one ability in the matchup the player has to react to on sight. A Zac watching for a Q-key flip will misread the cast entirely; worse, the same sentence is the entry's only warning about being thrown toward tower.
audit.corrected: Fling is E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range. Poison Trail is Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root is never stated. Riot's text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' content wants.foe[2] instead says 'Fling you under tower or into minions to reset'.
audit.why: It is his kill combo and it is a sequence, not a single ability — the goo has to be on the ground before the flip. That makes it readable: goo down plus Singed walking at you is the tell, and it is also the moment Zac cannot answer with E, because the same goo grounds him. Described as 'fling you into minions', the player has no cue to watch for.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive first, then Fling into it, equals a root. Goo on the ground plus Singed approaching is the tell — and it is the one moment your E is grounded.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (Fling: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted')

audit.whatIsWrong: content mid claims Insanity Potion grants tenacity. Riot's description says only 'increased combat stats' and does not list tenacity; the Singed kit's flags carry antiHeal and nothing about tenacity, and tenacityAffected sits in the kit's needsResearch block as unknown.
audit.why: It is an unverifiable specific presented as fact, and it displaces the verifiable one. I replaced it with the Grievous Wounds effect, which is in Riot's own text and matters far more to Zac. I did not assert anything about tenacity in either direction.
audit.corrected: Removed the tenacity claim; stated the Grievous Wounds effect instead.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (Insanity Potion description; needsResearch.tenacityAffected is null)

audit.whatIsWrong: Zac wins only 40.63% over 128 games, but the content chart reads Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed — four even stages. The full layer is further out still: phases[].side reads Skill, Zac, Zac, Skill, Skill, Zac, Zac, giving Zac four stages in a lane he loses by nearly 19 points.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are not even. That is when Mega Adhesive is ranked up and Zac's only engage is answered on a 17s cooldown from 1000 range while Singed farms and proxies freely. Moving that one cell to Singed makes the content chart read Skill 3 / Singed 4, which is an honest description of a 40.63% lane. I changed one cell, not four, because levels 1-3 genuinely are a farming skill check.
audit.corrected: win[3] Skill -> Singed, with the grounding as the stated reason.

notes: Zac's worst matchup in this slice (40.63% over 128 games) and the entry was missing the two facts that explain the number. (1) Mega Adhesive GROUNDS — grounding shuts off dashes, and Elastic Slingshot is Zac's only dash and only engage. From 1000 range on a 17s rank-1 cooldown, Singed deletes Zac's engage by putting goo on the floor before Zac ever charges. Neither layer mentions grounding once; the full layer instead names Fling as matchup-defining. (2) Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving Cell Division blob healing — which is Zac's entire sustain model. The content layer already noticed that level 6 is 'where the WR bleeds' and gave the wrong reason for it. Also fixed: 'Fling (Q)' -> Fling is E (Q is Poison Trail), and added the Mega-Adhesive-then-Fling root sequence from Riot's text. REMOVED AN UNVERIFIABLE CLAIM: content mid asserted Insanity Potion grants tenacity. Riot's text says only 'increased combat stats', the kit carries no tenacity flag, and needsResearch.tenacityAffected is null — so I replaced the claim with the Grievous Wounds effect rather than asserting anything about tenacity either way.
